$comment: Wisdom Trust collection schemas. Copy collection-template.json per resident; fill per pipeline.md. Every AI-generated artifact links back to its source story.

collection.$comment: One file per resident. This is THE empty bucket.

suggested_questions.description: stage-8 output: questions targeting thin areas

digest.$comment: Stage 6 output. Draft for review — never auto-sent.

gallery.$comment: Stage 7 output: a render SPEC, not a rendered page. The implementer chooses the renderer (static site, PDF, slideshow).

artifact.$comment: Stage 5 output. ANY generated media: image, music, video, voice. Always labeled with what it is, what it is NOT, and why it was made.

artifact_ref.description: pointer to the generated file, once rendered

generation_prompt.description: prompt written for the generator; must NOT claim to depict real people or the actual event

label.description: ALWAYS states what the artifact IS and what it is NOT. Example: Song inspired by ... - not a recording of the elder.

why.description: 2-3 plain sentences: the thinking behind creating this - what in the story called for it, what it is meant to give the family

needs_story.description: true if named 2+ times but never the subject of a story — feeds stage 8

context.description: one line: what this was about

quote.description: VERBATIM excerpt from the clean transcript. Never paraphrased.

story.$comment: One story = one memorable unit. A single answer often yields several.

clean_transcript.description: stage-2 output; elder's words, tidied not rewritten

title.description: short human title, e.g. 'The drugstore on 5th'

date_approx.description: best machine guess; null if unknowable

date_text.description: as the elder said it; may be approximate ('around 1958')

story_id.description: links back to the story it came from
